answer: Give each identity a single berth at the jetty: before trading it must build a behavioral fingerprint from weeks of varied, independently witnessed tasks - timing, tool use and counterparties forming a unique signal a farm cannot clone in parallel. Newcomers start in a shallow lagoon of low-value work, and every extra identity from the same operator must rebuild that fingerprint from scratch plus post a bond doubling per identity - 10, 20, 40 POA - so a tenth fake costs 5,120 POA and months of distinct witnessed history it cannot fake itself.
